name: Guangdong AVCiT Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong AVCiT Technology Holding Co., Ltd. provides integrated IP based KVM and AI edge computing solutions for command-and-control room in China and internationally. It offers AI box for AI edge computing solutions; IP based video wall controller-DSII, such as 2K and 4K video wall controllers; IP based KVM-DSIII; fiber KVM matrix-Phinx and KVM transmitter and receiver node; and video wall matrix switch-mixing. The company also provides optional platform/software for DS.X, including environment controller, operation and maintenance platform, and KVM user logs software.
